102000101.text: We must investigate further to find out why the Abyss Order has been so active lately.

102000201.text: *sigh* Shame I only get to listen in from the other side of the window and don't get to join in the debate. I'd love to give my two cents...

102000202.text: Say what? What's up, what's up? Paimon wants in!

102000203.text: Recently, all the customers at the tavern have been debating the exact same topic: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?"

102000205.text: Must be someone who can floor a whole gang of hilichurls with just one punch!

102000207.text: Wow... then it really must be tough to become the strongest of all.

102000210.text: But anyway... Is there, like, a general agreement in the city on who it is, or...?

102000211.text: Hah. Expecting people to come to a swift and straightforward consensus in the City of Freedom is like expecting Fisherman's Toast to drop out of the sky.

102000212.text: Everyone's got their own opinion, backed up by a unique set of cherry-picked information... But let's be honest, that's what makes the discussion so impassioned and entertaining.

102000213.text: Mainstream opinion is polarized, with most people supporting one of two candidates.

102000214.text: One is the Dandelion Knight, the other is the Darknight Hero.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Patton about recent conversation topics

102000301.text: Patton was right about one thing.

102000304.text: If everyone's got their own opinion and can't be persuaded...

102000305.text: ...How are we ever gonna find out who Mondstadt's strongest fighter is?

102000308.text: Bet the Knights have got an official ranking table for this kind of thing!

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

102000701.text: Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

102000702.text: You want to know who I think the toughest fighter is?

102000703.text: In my opinion, that would be the finest adventurer of them all — Stanley.

102000704.text: Guild Master Cyrus is up there with the toughest, too, but only Stanley can take on the bloodthirsty beasts of the Mare Jivari!

102000705.text: Bloodthirsty beasts of the Mare Jivari? Sounds terrifying!

102000706.text: D'you reckon you'd be scared if you were faced with one of those?

102000710.text: Sensible choice. Safety first and all that.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

102000801.text: Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

102000802.text: Er... *hic* The strongest fighter of them all?

102000804.text: Why? Grand Master Jean is so strong... she can take out a Ruin Guard with just a few slashes of her sword. *hic*

102000805.text: And she could wipe out the three hilichurl tribes at Dadaupa Gorge all by her... *hic* self.

102000806.text: Otherwise, we wouldn't have such a carefree existence... with nothing to do...

102000807.text: It's true that Jean makes people feel they're in safe hands.

102000808.text: Meanwhile, this guy is drunk as a skunk!

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

102000901.text: Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

102000902.text: The strongest fighter? I don't pay much attention to that sort of thing...

102000903.text: Huh. Paimon thought bartenders had some kind of special information sources.

102000904.text: Just like they have an exclusive supplier of wine?

102000905.text: Exactly! That's what Paimon was getting at.

102000906.text: I have no involvement in any intelligence-gathering operation.

102000907.text: But if you made me pick someone, it would be the Darknight Hero.

102000908.text: I've heard some stories about him. Apparently, he once rescued a city dweller from the Abyss Order.

102000909.text: There it is — the barman's top-secret intelligence!

102000910.text: Speaking of the Abyss Order, their minions are really stirring up trouble all over the place, aren't they?

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

102001001.text: Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

102001002.text: Eh? The most macho in Mondstadt?

102001003.text: ...She's a little girlie who wears red.

102001005.text: That's right! I found this out one day about half a month ago, when I went to the Stormbearer Mountains looking for inspiration for my new song.

102001008.text: I witnessed the most powerful destructive force I have ever seen in my life!

102001009.text: I'm telling you, it completely changed the whole landscape in that part of the mountains!

102001011.text: I was hiding behind a bush and I saw this little girlie in red clothing running into the distance, leaving a trail of destruction in her wake.

102001012.text: *sigh* But I don't know if anyone will believe me.

102001013.text: Hmm... Now that you mention it, the idea of a tiny little girl wielding that much destructive power is a little far-fetched...

102001014.text: You want to know what I think? I think she has a treasure nobody else knows about.

102001015.text: Maybe even the most powerful treasure in all of Mondstadt!

102001017.text: #{NICKNAME}, did Paimon imagine that or did you hear it too?

102001018.text: It's... just a guess. I mean... No, it's a bard's razor-sharp intuition!

102001020.text: How can you say such a thing...

102001023.text: So, this girl. What's her name?

102001024.text: Ah... I do not know her name. I do not see her often in Mondstadt.

102001025.text: Hey, I am telling the truth! You gotta believe me!

102001026.text: Hmmm... Doesn't sound like much to go on...

102001022.text: #Thank you, amig{M#o}{F#a}! Ah, I am so happy to meet a true amig{M#o}{F#a}. Who would have thought—

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

102001602.text: You can call me Six-Fingered José, it's okay.

102001603.text: I am a beloved bard of Mondstadt... Or I should say, I used to be beloved.

102001605.text: Oh? You want to hear my latest song? I call it Ode to a Morning Breeze.

102001606.text: ...I just need to tune my instrument.

102001608.text: I am so sorry. I have had no audience to play for for so long that now my strings are a little... I'll sing for you next time.

102001610.text: #Are you kidding me, amig{M#o}{F#a}? Mondstadt is known all over for its songs from the pastures!

102001611.text: But lately a mysterious bard appeared in this place. I checked all over, but I can't find out anything about him.

102001612.text: Since he came here, my audience has slowly disappeared.

102001613.text: I did consider a battle of the bards...

102001614.text: But I think even I would be seduced by his beautiful voice...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

102000601.text: I—I'm fine! I'm not hurt! Sorry for bumping into you.

102000603.text: Hey, look, there's some writing on here...

102000604.text: "Explosion inside city wall, grounded be thy woe," "Explosions can hurt people, Jean can be dreadful," "Mondstadt be bombed, Klee be doomed..."

102000606.text: Mr. Kaeya wrote these down for me, um... they're, um... survival rules.

102000608.text: Y—Yeah... Rules that I must absolutely never break under any circumstances.

102000613.text: Ah, I forgot to introduce myself!

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask Jean about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

102000401.text: Oh, Master Jean! Sorry to bother you, we're collecting intel on the strongest fighter in Mondstadt.

102000402.text: Do you have... uh, one of those... official Knights of Favonius—verified ranking table... thingies?

102000404.text: I am sorry, but I cannot help. I do not have any relevant documentation on that topic...

102000406.text: #Paimon was hoping {NICKNAME} would at least make the top five.

102000407.text: Hehe. Well, although I do not have the data to make such an assessment, I will say that my faith in our Honorary Knight's abilities has never wavered.

102000409.text: Recently, one of the Abyss Order's Mages has been active near the city, although he is keeping a low profile.

102000410.text: If you are staying around Mondstadt, please be on the lookout for danger.

102000411.text: Given your... well, high-ranking fighting strength, I trust you will be able to help keep the area safe.

102000412.text: #Awesome! After {NICKNAME} defeats the Abyss Order, {F#she'll}{M#he'll} climb up that ranking table faster than {F#she}{M#he} climbs up all those cliffs!

102000415.text: Well, either way, smashing the Abyss Order to bits is the right thing to do.

102000416.text: Hehe. I like your enthusiasm. It is infectious.

subQuests.subQuestName: Leave the Knights of Favonius office

102001101.text: Hey, I'm doing some adventurer's training... alcohol tolerance training, to be precise... Wanna join me?

102001201.text: You seem to have had one too many.

102001202.text: Really? Let me see... eight beers, five wines, seven ciders... Not so much!

102001203.text: I'm no match for those legendary Mondstadt adventurers who can drink half of Cider Lake's worth of wine...

102001204.text: ...Only a figure of speech? Really? No wonder... I could never figure out how they could afford so much wine on an adventurer's income...

102001301.text: What kind of liquor do you prefer?

102001302.text: Me...? Beer. I don't like it that much though...

102001303.text: It's just that... beggars can't be choosers...

102001304.text: As long as it gets me drunk, it's all good... Don't you agree?

102001502.text: #Do you want to hear my latest composition? I put my whole heart into it, and also my soul. How about it, amig{M#o}{F#a}?

102001702.text: Leaving so soon? You are a busy bee.

102001703.text: If you ever have time to spare, I won't complain if you come here and show me some appreciation.

102001801.text: Hi! Are you here to try Mondstadt's famous wine too?

102001902.text: What do you mean? I'm off work...

102001903.text: I sleep better when I've had a little tipple after work to take the edge off.

102001904.text: ...Huh? What difference does it make when I slack off all day anyway, you say?

102001905.text: Well there's nothing to do because... because Mondstadt is just so peaceful, that's why.

102001906.text: I'm sure my life would have been more interesting if I'd gone with the Adventurers' Guild instead...

102001908.text: Just think. As an adventurer, you'd get to go explore wherever you wanted, literally anywhere in the seven nations of Teyvat...

102001909.text: And best of all, you can make a living from it! What could be more fun than that?

102002201.text: Hey, I'm doing some adventurer's training... alcohol tolerance training, to be precise... Wanna join me?

102002302.text: #Do you want to hear my latest composition? I put my whole heart into it, and also my soul. How about it, amig{M#o}{F#a}?

102002401.text: Hi! Are you here to try Mondstadt's famous wine too?

102002502.text: The apple cider from the Dawn Winery is a special at Angel's Share.

102002503.text: You can try my special cocktail if you want. The cocktail is on the house if it's your first time here.

102002602.text: You want to know about me?

102002603.text: I've been working as a bartender here for more than a decade. I'm employed by the Dawn Winery, like everyone else.

102002604.text: I'm not that interested in alcohol, but it's my job so...

102002605.text: I mean, I'm not like Diona at Cat's Tail. I heard she hates alcohol.

102002606.text: Occasionally, Master Diluc, the owner of the winery, will cover my shift.

102002607.text: Days off are precious after all, so I'm very thankful to him for that.

102002702.text: Really? Shouldn't drink too much anyway, I guess.
